mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the heat store was most worthwhile: the explanation showed how a separate circuit captures processor waste heat and stores it for later, while allowing the tank to be moved.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the inner screen was a plain intermediate step; its purpose became clearer only when it was fitted around the bench.

surprise.text: I was interested that the tank remains connected to collect fresh waste heat whenever the processor runs, yet can later move with the beds.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The materials and connections suggested their purposes, although the screen’s adjustment was unclear until it was fitted.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the movable heat store and growing beds are used later, especially after learning how the nook conserves warmth.
